target_customer: Mid sized and growing companies buying OKR, performance and now AI hiring tools (HR and talent teams)
problem: Companies struggle to align teams on goals and run performance reviews. Peoplebox began as an OKR and performance platform and now sells an AI recruiter, Nova, plus talent management.
product_category: OKR, performance management and AI recruiting software

founders.name: Alagu M
founders.background_notes: From the YC page; led product at Practo.

technical_complexity.rationale: OKR and review software is standard SaaS with HRIS, Slack and Teams integrations. The later AI interviewer is harder but came after founding.

defensibility.rationale: Goal and review history creates some lock in, but many OKR and performance tools existed and features are easy to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: These players stayed independent in the sources found. Peoplebox moved toward AI recruiting in 2025.

market_need_then: Remote and hybrid teams needed goal alignment tooling. Peoplebox's October 2022 coverage listed customers such as Razorpay, Postman, Exotel and Khatabook.

branding.domain_note: Uses peoplebox.ai; PEOPLEBOX trademark filed 2019-12-06 by Peoplebox Inc.

identity.voice_and_tone: Product marketing; Nova presented as the most human like AI recruiter.

brand_strength.rationale: Modest. No press on the brand itself, and the name was generic for HR software.

pivots.to: AI talent platform led by Nova, an AI recruiter
pivots.why: Company blog announced an AI employee for talent teams on February 12, 2025; reasons beyond that not stated.

outcome_analysis: Peoplebox is active with about 75 staff and claims 500 to 600 customers. It reinvented itself in 2025 around the Nova AI recruiter, riding the AI hiring wave. Public funding is thin: a Nexus investment in 2019 and a YC investment reported in October 2022, with no sourced amounts. Growth appears real but its capital history is unclear.
notes: Aggregators give conflicting totals ($0.5M, $1.1M, $1.6M) and dates; none are recorded as rounds. Venture Intelligence (2022-10-14) is the only dated source for the 2019 and 2022 investments. Competitor list empty because available competitor lists (Lattice, Betterworks, 15Five, Weekdone) are undated aggregator or vendor pages from 2025 or later. One aggregator names different founders (Vignesh Girishankar, Sasidhar Vangaveti); this conflicts with the YC page and is not used.
